notes: Ground truth. Handlers are registered by id via registerHandler(). Every other invoker ultimately delegates here or to another process.
Prints to stdout. Always available. Used as the fallback notify backend when no other channel is configured.
OAuth 2.0, gmail.send scope only. Requires GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN, GMAIL_FROM env vars. Handler not yet implemented.
Creates a watch_instance node and registers it with the runtime scheduler. Poll interval is a hint — the source's own rate limits win.
Uses GITHUB_TOKEN if available (raises rate limit to 5000/hr). Handler not yet implemented — will land in batch 4.

Searches the open web via a self-hosted SearXNG instance. Reads SEARXNG_URL env (default http://127.0.0.1:8080). SearXNG fans out to Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Wikipedia, GitHub, StackOverflow, arxiv and aggregates the results. No API key, no quota. Candidates carry kind=web_result, id=URL, description=result snippet, and null GitHub-specific fields so the proposal prompt can handle both candidate kinds uniformly.
OpenAI-compatible chat completions. If accept_from is set, the returned model must satisfy it or the call is rejected.
Analyzes candidates with an LLM, sends a proposal email with per-candidate approve/reject URLs. Does not adopt.

HTTP endpoint at /agentry/* that records approve/reject decisions on pending proposals. Not a capability that produces anything — it's a long-running service. Started by the runtime, not invoked per-call.
Submits a task to the DeepSeek Harness business API. Returns a task id; does not wait for the result. Use agent.dsh_poll to wait.
Polls a task submitted via agent.dsh until completion or timeout.

Wrapper around another notify capability. Tries primary first (default notify.email.gmail); on failure falls back to notify.console, which writes to stdout so the message appears in the HF Space log. Use this anywhere a notification must not silently fail. The fallback body includes the primary's error so it is visible in the log.
Reasons about a harness failure. Records a gap if a capability is missing. Fast — uses llm.openai_compat, not agent.dsh.
Reads a decided proposal, writes each approved candidate as a live capability node, retires the gap and its watches, sends a follow-up email. Idempotent via adopted_at. This is how the graph grows.

The agentry operating system. Persistent sessions with isolated cwd, env, and process table. Filesystem shared under work/<session>/. Dispatches to agentry-kernel on 127.0.0.1:7864. Actions: session.create|get|list|cwd|env, fs.read|write|list, shell.spawn|write|read|kill|list, python.run|install|version, node.run|install|npx|version, git.clone|status|commit|log|version, proc.start|status|stop|logs|list, health. Not a bash sandbox — a typed execution environment with state.

Deep reasoning path. Submits a task to the DeepSeek Harness in a dedicated reasoner workspace (no AGENTS.md, so no recursion). The harness uses its own tools — web search, fetch, file reads — before answering. Returns the same shape as agentry.reason. On failure, callers should fall back to agentry.reason.
https://github.com/microsoft/playwright

Force an immediate save-to-GitHub of the state directory. Triggers an out-of-cycle commit+push so events that matter (capability adopted) survive a crash before the next autosave tick. Idempotent when there's nothing to commit.
Reads an approved candidate, gathers repo facts, asks the LLM for a spec, renders a .mjs handler + seed .json. Does not write the graph.
Writes a trial node, prepares the trial session, imports the handler, runs accept(). On pass, clears the trial marker. On fail, retires the trial node.
Deep reasoning on Groq with native tool use (web_search, fetch_url). Loops up to 5 turns calling tools, then produces the final JSON. Same input/output contract as agentry.reason.

Search local graph, npm registry, MCP server registry, GitHub, and web for existing tools that could solve a problem. Returns ranked candidates with fit scores. Use this before synthesizing a new capability from scratch.
